observedFacts: Tax-free shops are authorized export-goods sales places under the Consumption Tax Act, and authorization is granted store by store.
The programme describes non-resident eligibility and personal-use conditions, with purchase thresholds and restrictions on use in Japan.
Goods must be taken out of Japan.
limitations: The source supports a point-of-sale tax-free programme, not a current refund-method amount.
Rolex retailer participation and any operator fee are not established by this evidence.
